conversion: External jobs, operations and machines are zero-based; domain IDs are NAME/job_{j+1}/op_{k+1}, M{m+1}. Mode IDs m{machine}_t{duration}_v{identical-pair occurrence}, counted only within the operation. Raw task mode is a global external mode index.
extraction: data_cell.txt is the unmodified data cell; data.json is its literal data assignment. Source notebook is hashed separately.
reference_origin: New fixed reference from direct PyJobShop 0.0.9 CP-SAT modeling, independent of SmartSOM adapter. Not a published source timetable.
